milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate close to the red wool pillar and face toward it, confirming visual identification. Target [-5, 1, 0] is the center of the 3-block-tall red wool pillar in the west room (spawn-relative). max_distance=5 requires the player to enter or be near the west room doorway. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the wool, not just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the east room and face toward the brown bed, confirming visual identification. Target [7, 0, 0] is the foot of the brown bed on the oak plank platform in the east room (spawn-relative). max_distance=5 requires the player to enter or be near the east room doorway. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed. The bed was confirmed placed successfully via sandbox verification (facing=south, foot at z=0, head at z=1).
